title: Distributed data-driven process modeling optimization method and system
assignee: East China University of Science and Technology

pse.problem: Data security and user privacy concerns due to the need for collecting decentralized node data from different devices in existing centralized data-driven modeling decision-making processes
pse.solution_function: A distributed method performs data preprocessing, model selection, model fitting, and model deployment on local nodes. The method aggregates node models to obtain a global model which is used for decision-making optimization. Evolutionary optimization is performed in combination with the optimization strategy to search for feasible solutions.
pse.solution_structure: The system comprises distributed full-process equipment or cross-regional sub-factories (nodes), a parameter server, and a carrier for decision-making optimization.
pse.solution_implementation: Nodes preprocess local offline data set and online data set to train node models. The parameter server aggregates node models to form a global model, which is sent to the corresponding nodes. Decision-making optimization is performed using the global model and node model on the carrier, with evolutionary optimization and an optimization strategy applied.
pse.effect: The distributed method addresses data security concerns by eliminating the need for centralized data collection, potentially improving privacy protection.
